title: Explicit lifecycle adoption and lossless intake provenance
outcomes: Configured projects create complete task contracts consistently and adopt open legacy tasks through reviewable recoverable state migration.

in: Explicit project lifecycle settings, preview/apply/rollback, open task adoption or needs-configuration reporting, full review-bundle contract/provenance preservation and local skill instructions
boundaries: Canonical repository controller; quiescent task queue; existing task and integration locks plus durable migration journal

decision_rights: Authorize execution and choose model; GO on 2026-09-13
Implement bounded contract choices and document compatibility behavior

constraints: Stack pin updates and legacy schema migration remain distinct from explicit lifecycle adoption. Never infer settings or authority from a version pin.

Adoption requires a validated explicit settings document and a quiescent repository. Preserve existing execution overrides, selected phase profiles, verification commands and every historical done/blocked record; report records requiring manual configuration.

Default dry-run is nonmutating. Apply persists exact before/after bytes and intent before writes, checks snapshots for drift and is idempotent. Interrupted migration blocks execution until explicit retry/rollback. Rollback refuses unrelated edits and never overwrites advanced task history.

All intake paths use resolved defaults/overrides, retain model/workspace/release/phase contracts, create pending requirement coverage when needed, and inherit no prior completion or publication authority.

Export/import remains a review/reconcile artifact, not executable cross-host handoff. Preserve full task and selected project contract/provenance fields; mark external evidence references and omitted runtime/artifact contents explicitly.

Local skills describe actual phase inputs, outputs, scope, evidence and handoff. Selected lessons cite agent-brain and predecessor viggo-agent-skills; no vault writer, mandatory broad skill chain or global edits.
No GitHub Actions; named provider/target configuration is explicit onboarding input.

quality_attributes.scenario: Adopt a project with done and overridden tasks
Interrupted apply or rollback after concurrent edits
quality_attributes.measure: Silent lost state or runnable partial migration
Lost contract/provenance fields or inherited completion authority

quality_attributes.scenario: Update runtime pin without adoption configuration

risks: Migration coordinates supported repository writers; arbitrary edits remain protected by exact snapshot drift checks, not an OS sandbox.
Review bundles preserve references but do not supply absent external proof objects or active runtime transfer.
